_doc: Quests: hand-written chains of jobs and city goals. See missions/README.md. `when` starts a quest, each step waits on its own conditions or on a job, and `reward` pays out at the end.

quests.title: Grand Opening
quests.desc: Every real city needs a real bank. Grow the town, then build Second National Bank.

reward.note: Armored escort jobs are on the dispatch radio

quests.title: The Bunker
quests.desc: Somebody noticed the new bunker. A payphone is ringing for you.

steps.text: Steal a van for the crew
Rob the bank and get to the Bunker

reward.note: The Bunker is upgraded. The Kingpin route is open

quests.title: Lights On
quests.desc: A blackout hit part of town. Get the substation running, then make sure it never happens again.

steps.text: Mayor: build enough power for everyone (100%)

quests.title: Clean Streets
quests.desc: The dens are multiplying. Raid three of them with the police, then give the city a proper headquarters.

reward.note: Crime is down across the city
